tools.name: list_open_alerts
tools.description: List the open alerts in the SOC queue (may include benign/decoy alerts).

tools.name: query_telemetry
tools.description: Search raw telemetry events (process/auth/dns/netflow). `filter` matches any field substring; optional `window`.

tools.name: lookup_host
tools.description: Return facts about a host (owner, role, notes).

tools.name: lookup_account
tools.description: Return facts about an account (privilege level, normal working hours).

tools.name: check_ioc
tools.description: Look up reputation for an indicator (hash/IP/domain). Indicator reputation is volatile and not authoritative.

tools.name: get_baseline
tools.description: Return the known-normal activity pattern for an entity (the established baseline).

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Return the ordered activity timeline for one entity (host or account).

tools.name: open_investigation
tools.description: Open an investigation case. Returns a case id used by later actions.

tools.name: raise_finding
tools.description: Record a finding on a case: the entity involved, the TTP you believe is in play, and your confidence (0-1).

tools.name: contain_host
tools.description: Isolate a host from the network. This has real business cost if the host is benign.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Escalate the case to a higher tier (tier1/tier2/IR).

tools.name: close_case
tools.description: Close the investigation with your verdict. Returns the graded outcome.
